summary: Agenta is a self-hosted LLMOps platform designed to help teams manage prompts, evaluate language model outputs, and observe application behaviour in production. It provides a centralised workspace for collaborative prompt engineering and testing. The software is released under the MIT licence.
goodFor: Engineering teams building production applications on top of large language models who require collaborative prompt management and systematic evaluation.
watchOut: Evaluating and observing LLM workflows can generate significant data volumes, meaning you need to monitor storage and performance scaling carefully as traffic grows.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
